title: GTA 6's Vice City Is Real Miami. Real Miami Has a Problem
lines: GTA 6's Vice City is based on real Miami.
But real Miami has a problem you won't see in the game.
The city sits just a few feet above the sea. About six feet, on average.
During the highest tides of the year, sea water floods the streets, even on sunny days.
And a sea wall won't fix it. Miami is built on limestone, full of holes like a sponge.
So the water comes up from underneath the ground.
Miami Beach is spending hundreds of millions of dollars on pumps, and on raising entire streets.
Vice City, on the other hand, stays dry. Follow for more!
caption:
GTA 6's Vice City is inspired by Miami 🌴 But real Miami sits only ~6 ft above sea level on porous limestone, so king tides flood streets even on sunny days and water rises from underground. Miami Beach is spending hundreds of millions on pumps and raised roads.

Fan-made explainer, not affiliated with Rockstar Games. Sources: NOAA (sunny-day flooding), USGS (Biscayne aquifer), City of Miami Beach.
